# Question 1: Pricing
## 1.1: Option Pricing using MCS

```{python}
# Define Parameters
n = 1000000 # Number of simulations
delta = T / m # Time increment (monthly)

# Ensure reproduceability
np.random.seed(42)

# Asset Price Simulation
S_paths = np.zeros((n, m + 1)) # initilize paths
S_paths[:, 0] = S0  # define t0 with s0
for i in range(1, (m+1)): # iterativly simulate n asset price paths over m periods
    S_paths[:, i] = S_paths[:, (i-1)] * np.exp(-.5 * sigma**2 * delta + sigma * np.sqrt(delta) * np.random.standard_normal(n))
```

## 1.2: Price Comparison of European vs. Asian Call Option
```{python}
## European Option
np.random.seed(42) # to ensure reproduceability
Z = np.random.standard_normal(n) 
path_terminal = S0 * np.exp((r - 0.5 * sigma**2) * T + sigma * np.sqrt(T) * Z) # terminal prices
psi_euro = np.maximum(path_terminal-K,0) # compute payoffs
p_euro = np.exp(-r*T) * np.mean(psi_euro)
```
